class Runner { async inOrderSteps<T>(items: (() => Promise<void>)[], options: Options): Promise<void> { for (const item of items) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await client.put(item);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await audit.save(item);
} } }

new Runner().inOrderSteps([], {reason: "Each update reads the previous write"});
